read: Route pages, held copies scanned with grep for region/country/launch/expansion: evidence/product-class/runs/20261012T104936Z-s01-sources/items/106-bigcommerce.co.uk/text.txt (https://www.bigcommerce.co.uk/payments/bigcommerce-payments/; the route's https://www.bigcommerce.co.uk/payments/ itself is not held), line 263 'Initially, BigCommerce Payments is available only to US- and UK-based merchants with self-serve and retail plans. Additional regions and countries will be launching soon. See BigCommerce documentation or contact support to confirm whether your account qualifies.'; evidence/product-class/runs/20261013T003518Z-s01-a2-sources/items/012-commerce.com/text.txt and 013-commerce.com/text.txt (the two held commerce.com/press pages; line 31 'with international expansion planned in subsequent phases', line 59 'with plans to expand internationally in future phases'), nothing on what adding a country involves. Searches: python3 -I method/corpus_search.py bigcommerce "new country" "new countries" "additional country" "additional countries" "new region" "new regions" "additional region" "additional regions" --max 5 (4 documents: merchants expanding into new regions, and the 'launching soon' line); python3 -I method/corpus_search.py bigcommerce "launching soon" "coming soon" "expand internationally" "international expansion" "rollout" "roll out" "waitlist" --with "BigCommerce Payments" --max 5 (4 documents); python3 -I method/corpus_search.py bigcommerce "supported country" "supported countries" "eligible country" "eligible countries" "available country" "available countries" "country availability" --max 5 (8 documents: merchant-side country requirements of gateways). Read: 100-bigcommerce.com (https://www.bigcommerce.com/payments/bigcommerce-payments/, rendered.html FAQ 'Where is it available?': 'Initially, BigCommerce Payments is available only to US-based merchants with self-serve and retail plans. Additional regions and countries will be launching soon.'); 012-commerce.com lines 29-35; 003-support.bigcommerce.com (Connecting with PayPal) lines 74-79, 'All countries supported by PayPal are supported by BigCommerce, except India and Israel.' None says what adding a country or region involves on BigCommerce's side. The point says only 'not in what was read' and stands. Aside for the facts run: the held US page (12 Oct) says 'US-based' where the held UK page says 'US- and UK-based'.
